title: Google Review Impact
takeaway: Responding to negative Google reviews can improve a business's online reputation.

data.label: Percentage of Consumers Reading Reviews
data.evidence: Studies show that 93% of consumers read online reviews before visiting a business.

data.label: Percentage of Consumers Who Read Reviews Before Visiting
data.evidence: Studies show that 85% of consumers read online reviews before visiting a business.

data.label: Percentage of Consumers Who Read Reviews Before Visiting (Local)
data.evidence: Studies show that 88% of consumers read online reviews before visiting a local business.

data.label: Percentage of Reviews Based on a Single Interaction
data.evidence: A surprising number of reviews, around 70%, are based on a single interaction - a service call, a website visit, or a brief conversation.

data.label: Percentage Increase in Leads/Sales with Positive Reviews
data.evidence: Businesses with consistently positive reviews often see a 20-30% increase in leads and sales.

narration: Responding to negative Google reviews demonstrates a commitment to customer satisfaction and can improve a business's online reputation. Businesses that respond to reviews are perceived as more trustworthy and reliable, leading to increased customer trust and potential sales.
